title: Export Pack Manifest
description: Manifest for an exported framework content pack. Describes pack contents, provenance, version, and compatibility requirements.

pack_id.description: Unique identifier for this pack (format: pack_[type]_[timestamp])

pack_type.description: Type of content pack: style-pack (style guides + rubrics), doctrine-pack (principles + doctrine), workflow-pack (workflows + agents), command-pack (command specs), full-framework (complete framework)

framework_version.description: Framework version this pack was exported from (e.g., Phase 7)

source_repo.description: Repository or project this pack was exported from

description.description: Description of pack contents and intended use

items.description: List of all items included in this pack

item_path.description: Relative path to item within pack

item_type.description: Type of item (doctrine, style-pack, workflow, agent, command, schema, template)

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of item content for integrity verification

dependencies.description: Other packs or framework components required by this pack

compatibility_notes.description: Notes on framework version compatibility, breaking changes, or migration requirements

selective_import_supported.description: Whether this pack supports selective import of individual items (true) or must be imported as a whole (false)

created_by.description: Agent or user that created this pack

checksum.description: Overall pack checksum for integrity verification
